'''''Argus''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The shuttle was launched from the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Ardent (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Ardent'']], carrying [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. The shuttle was destroyed by [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] that were attacking the Cruiser.
